verdict.rationale: Retell's docs say single- and multi-prompt agents can connect to a remote MCP server and call that server's tools during a live voice or chat conversation, which delivers the MCP-client story. Retell's own MCP server is server-side and not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP tool calls work in practice, evidence of support beyond remote servers (e.g., local servers or auth/configuration depth), and clarity on whether node-based flow agents also support MCP.
